headline: MSCI Completes Acquisition of First Street
summary: NEW YORK, August 03, 2026--MSCI Inc. (NYSE: MSCI) has completed its acquisition of First Street, a leading provider of physics-based climate risk data and analytics across more than 2.4 billion structures worldwide.
